content: Our baseline pretraining model was a reimplementation of that given in BIBREF0. Hyperparameters were generally identical, but we trained on only 2 GPUs with (up to) 4,000 tokens per batch. This difference in batch size meant we used 6,000 warm up steps with the learning rate schedule of BIBREF16.
